notes.title: Update 1.5 - Moving Train Escape, New Prison Floor, Many items!
notes.notes:
[h2]New items![/h2]
[b]Pickaxe:[/b] you will buy it off a new NPC that sells pickaxes for 1$
[b]Coal:[/b] mine coal rocks underground to get coal
[b]Coal Pack[/b]: craftable by 2 coals
[b]Train Fix Kit:[/b] 2x coal packs, 1x screws, 1x oil - not hard to get

[h2]How to escape via train?[/h2]
1) fix it
2) it will start moving with a big cho-cho sound that everyone on the map will hear
3) guards will try to come to knock you all out and stop the train
- if guards stop the train you can just interact with it to resume it, no need to fix it again
4) when the train reaches the finish line, everyone around it will escape with it
currently, I plan so the train will take 90 seconds to reach the end.

[previewyoutube=67yBTTKA6OI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/717038ddfb2a3140c0b96ec844f73dfad29c29fa.gif[/img]

[h1]New[/h1][list]
[*]New Floor - Train Rails - You can fix a train and start it - will take 90 seconds to arrive at the escape point.
[*]Pistol - Currently only available in the lobby, will be added to the game soon.
[*]Advanced Knocked-out system - You will be sent to the infirmary instead of getting up(prisoners will be sent to their cells at night).
[*]Item - Segway for guards - you can buy it from the guard shop, hard to control but fast.
[*]Map UI marking - now when you open the map you can see many markings on it - escape points, doors, fences, and much more!
[*]Hitboxes - now you can hit players in the head, body, legs, and arms instead of the general hitbox which was inaccurate.
[*]Rlayers can revive knocked-out players from their same role.
[*]Mini map for all floors of the prison - not just the main one!
[*]NPC in the train rails floor - you can buy from him a pickaxe and a pistol.
[*]Item - Pickaxe - use it to mine coal rocks on the train rails floor.
[*]Item - Coal and Coal Pack - a pack is craftable from 2 coals.
[*]Item - Train Fix Kit - use it to fix the train on the new floor.
[*]Added Crouching - Press X to toggle crouching
[*]Added Leaning - hold control+Q or control+E to lean left or right
[*]Now the X axis of the looking direction of players are synced, so for example, if they look up, their character will look up on other people's screen.
[*]System that allows you to have smooth combat with guns(currently only pistols).
[*]Now new custom maps will need an infirmary point to mark where the knocked-out players will be sent(for maps without an infirmary point, they will teleport to their start position).
[/list]
[h1]Changed[/h1]
[list]
[*]Open lobby settings key was changed from C to G.
[/list]
[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*]There was a bug that prevented you from seeing most of the lobbies.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.4 - Join Games in Progress, Improved Melee Combat
notes.notes:
[h1]New[/h1][list]
[*]Now you can join games in progress!
[*]Improved the melee combat, now it feels much smoother.
[*]You can disable letting players join your game after it's started.
[*]If a game started with all the same roles(for example 2 prisoners), all new players will have the same role.
[*]Auto explore mode for only guards in-game has been disabled - You can still manually set it while starting a single-player game.
[*]Now you won't get any leaving penalty if you are in a game with 4 or fewer people(including you).
[*]Replaced the UI of players in the game with one with more icons.
[*]Now objects that were made by players like ladders, traps, and cameras, will be removed when their owner leaves.
[/list]
[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*]Now the sound detectors work perfectly.
[*]Problem with focusing on objects in the map editor(by pressing F)
[*]Slingshot animations
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3 - New Items, Better Spectator
notes.notes:
[h1]New[/h1][list]
[*] Reworked spectator mode for escaped players, now you can select players that your camera will follow.
[*] Placeable Ladders, now prisoners craft small fences to climb over fences - also is in custom maps as objects.
[*] Color changing texts that you can change added to the map editor.
[*] Placeable planks that prisoners can find and place to build a bridge to their freedom :) Only useful in custom games currently!
[*] Spectator mode supports multiple height levels - underground, vents - the boundaries for where the spectator camera can go are calculated automatically by the game.
[*] 21 new objects from the wooden objects collection in the map editor - they all support material/texture swap(also the ladders added to the map editor)
[*] New various objects for custom maps like an invisible wall, an invisible box that teleports prisoners to cells, and more.
[/list]
[h1]Changed[/h1]
[list]
[*]Now void environment in custom maps doesn't have a ground collider, if a player will fall off the map, he will be teleported back to his start position.
[*]Stairs snapping
[*]Now planks can be found on all maps - not just lost island - can be used to build bridges + craft ladders.
[*]Map Editor Wiki window updated
[/list]
[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Many small bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Prison Editor Is Released With Workshop Support With Over 350 Objects!
notes.notes:
After a very long month of hard work, the map editor is finally ready to be released!
I'm going to do more updates to it very soon so please share feedback with me, I will 100% read it :)

[h1]Notable Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Over 350 objects with many functions!
[*]Robust building system, you can use and customize snap presets to place and manipulate objects
[*]Up 100 Prison floors with no lag! - I made a system that makes you render only the current floor you are in so each time you move between floors, different items will be loaded. (each floor can be normal, underground/vents)
[*][h1]Teleportation System[/h1] - you choose for each teleport object a target and the players can use it
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/5e8a5a7e1b7d2db32e5bf0a10f50fe131116c85f.jpg[/img]
[*][h1]Maze system[/h1] - randomly generated, can have as many mazes as your want
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/0e2e547a161e459df8e1217d23b3489ee559e763.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/7a7306962600a1b7b5d14483a8c18cc1508630fa.png[/img]
[*][h1]Customize The Textures of Buildings![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/2e5476677c15731f2e3751ae51dc0c06ef87ed0b.png[/img]
[*][h1]Customize Restricted/Allowed Areas[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/040649b029dcd4c2e159eb3fb89439de8f5bb884.jpg[/img]
[*][h1]Premade Rooms[/h1] - All the rooms you know and love are premade - you can choose a room you want and place it right into your prison.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/adacee38df8a7f229a370663832ad8d6c474c6b6.jpg[/img]
[*][h1]New Room - Classroom[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/ceeec9bbbe1baf27a9a48af7dd42ef6203213a62.png[/img]
[*]Easy to publish - take a preview image from inside the game and publish it with 1 click
[*] In-game guide for the prison editor.
[*]Many optimization systems to make your prisons run smoothly.
[*]Option to add pre-baked reflections that will load when you join a game.
[*]Parent-Child system so you can manage the objects in your prison better
[/list]

notes.title: Price Drop to 5$ & Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Why I dropped the price only a week after the launch?[/h1]
[list]
[*] As the game needs a lot of people to play together I decided that lowering the price is the best option for the game - hopefully, will bring more players.
[*]I did a vote on the discord server on what price you can afford and most of you chose 4.99$
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858153/bce1d99e069490e041664863f9cb97c05eca90c3.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]The price might rise in the future as I add more updates to the game.[/h2]

I'm planning to release it on Friday but I might need to take another week to get it super polished, will try my best.

notes.title: Prison Editor Releasing Soon!
notes.notes:
I am excited to announce my upcoming Prison Editor which will allow you to create your very own prisons and customize them to your liking. 
- Ability to change wall, floor, and roof materials, the possibilities are endless.
- Publish your prisons on the steam workshop.
And the best part? The upgraded proof system ensures that if you build a prison in version 1.0, it will still work in 1.1.

I am planning to release the Prison Editor only a week or two after the launch of the game today, so get ready to take your gaming experience to the next level. With my upcoming Prison Editor, you can design your own prison and challenge your friends to escape from your customized fortress.

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to experience the ultimate prison simulation game with my new Prison Editor. Let the games begin!
